question: In which Five -Year Plan Indian government launched the New Economic Policy of India?
solution:
The correct answer is **Eighth**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The eighth five-year plan was** initiated in 1992** in a typically** new economic environment.**
 
• **New Economic Policy** in India was **Launched in July 1991.​**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **New economic policy**

 
 
• **India was trapped **with various **Macroeconomics problems like inflation, Fiscal deficit, Inflation and Inverse BOP** in the **90s.**.
 
• It was the policy consisting of **Liberalisation, privatisation, and globalisation **to reform the various sector of the economy.
 
• This Policy **Opened the Economy** and did some iconic **reforms to free economic activities.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Five Five-year in India**

 
 
• India chose to use the concept of **planning to develop the Indian economy.**
 
• This was** taken from Soviet Russia.**
 
• **Planning commission was established in march 1950.**
 
• The** first Five-year plan** was launched in ** April 1951 **targeting the agriculture sector and to re-establishment of the Indian economy.
 
• **2012-2017 was the last five-year plan India.**
 
• After this plan The **Planning commission was dissolved in 2014.**
 
• **NITI AYOG** was established** in January 2015 As the Think Tank** for Indian Economic planning.
